notes: WHAT A ROW IS: the sub-units the interface creates and attaches (addToOrganization) INTO an existing, EMPTY Aggregate Container when an order first tasks the unit (RL-20260927-03: populate in place, never delete and re-create). The container itself is created at init by the design's init rule (sec 3; ContainerTypeRule in the app) - 'container' records the type that rule lands for the row's units (composition_check.py --init-census), and the app reads it only to check the row's echelons at start-up. UG52 72.2.1 p1419: warfare-model units cannot hold subordinates, containers can.

KEY: 'key' is the type map's lookup key (functionId, SIDC echelon char, nationRole, nation) and 'mapRowIds' the type-map rows the app will look a unit up by (CreationPlan.MapRowId). A row with no mapRowIds is only ever reached through another row's 'compose'.

ENTRY ROLES: role UNIT = one catalogue-SIMULATED warfare-model unit (AggregateLevelAggregate.ope), created Aggregated; role CONTAINER = a sub-container (PseudoAggregate.ope), created Disaggregated and composed in turn - 'compose' names another row, or CATALOGUE = the template's own configured <subordinate> list read from its .entity (source 2).

PRECEDENCE of sources (design sec 4): (1) the STP TO (the unit's declared C2SIM subordinates - attach the existing init units, never re-create); (2) the catalogue's configured sub-units where the template carries them (CATALOGUE); (3) this authored table. For the cut-A units source (1) is EMPTY: the tasked units are the COA task-force units, which have no Superior and no Subordinate in the init; the TO's 15 relations sit on their TO twins.

DEPTH: recurse until the catalogue simulates the echelon (USA: CO, one BN-level cavalry unit; RUS: BN). The draft rows are depth MANEUVER (FM 3-96 1-6: the infantry battalions and the cavalry squadron are the IBCT's primary maneuver forces); the enablers are listed under 'omitted' for the owner's depth decision D-2.

NESTING (decision D-8): the rows keep the nested ORBAT (battalion sub-containers). For G1 the populate planner FLATTENS a row - every simulated leaf attached directly to the tasked container - because PA_Move_Along_Route.lua:133 ends each subordinate's move with the built-in move-to-location-retrograde-task, which a sub-container has no controller for, and no vendor plan exercises that case.

PROXY = a real catalogue unit of the wrong branch, mobility, echelon or service standing in; 'note' says which. The US catalogue has NO Army infantry unit at any echelon, no US Army battalion-level maneuver unit other than the Stryker cavalry squadron, no US engineer or brigade-support unit, and no infantry division container.

provenance keys: FM3-96 = FM 3-96 Brigade Combat Team, HQDA, January 2021 (supersedes 8 October 2015), chapter 1, paragraph numbers as cited; CAT = the named container template's configured subordinates (docs/experiments/AGGREGATE_CATALOGUE_2026-09-27.md sec 3); RTK = the vendor's Road to Kaunas scenario ORBAT (RoadToKaunas.scnx .orb/.oob); TASK = the C2SIM task text in data/IRONSTORM_CUTA_Order.xml.
ASCII only; CRLF; every row re-proved against the installed chain by composition_check.py.

VARIANTS (package C2): every row carries 'variant' - 'catalogue' (the C1 draft rows), 'authored' (FM 3-96 composition with the AUTHORED US types, flat leaf units per D-8) or 'all' (rows valid in both: 1-112 IN's companies, the ABCT's mech-heavy CAB). A resolver picks ONE variant (defaultVariant, or the run's setting) and uses the rows of that variant plus the 'all' rows; each variant covers each map row at most once. The catalogue rows come FIRST, so a resolver that ignores 'variant' and takes the first row of a map key gets the catalogue composition, which runs on the shipped SMS. composition_check.py gates the catalogue variant on the vendor chain and the authored variant on the DEPLOYED derived chain (docs/experiments/AGGREGATE_AUTHORED_UNITS_2026-09-27.md).

TIER 2A (2026-10-04, RL-20261004-06, owner Q1858): three more taskees of the FULL order are composed from PUBLIC doctrine (Distribution A: FM 3-96 Jan 2021, ATP 3-09.24 Mar 2022), never from the real units' 2026 MBCT conversions - the scenario is synthetic. 278 ACR (F-UCRVA-G) = the ABCT pattern (C-USA-RGT-UCRVA / -A); 56 SBCT (F-UCAW-H) = HQ + three Motorized BN (POL, Rosomak) as a LABELLED STAND-IN for the three Stryker infantry battalions + the Stryker cavalry squadron (C-USA-BDE-UCAW / -A; each stand-in entry says STAND-IN and WRONG NATION in its note); 169 FAB (F-UCF-H) = HHB + one cannon BN + one HIMARS BN (C-USA-BDE-UCF / -A, C-USA-BN-UCF, C-USA-BN-HIMARS). STAND-IN = a labelled PROXY or AUTHORED entry of another unit's type, chosen by ruling or because no closer type exists; the note names the unit it stands in for.

REFUSED (RL-20261004-06), NO ROW ON PURPOSE: 55 MEB (F-UCE-H) - FM 3-81 2-2, 2-25: beyond its HSC and signal company the MEB has no fixed structure and must be task-organized for every mission, so doctrine gives no composition to compose, and the catalogue has no US engineer, military police or CBRN unit to compose one from. 11 CAB (F-UCVRA-H) - FM 3-04 2-9: the CAB is attack, assault, general-support and air cavalry helicopter battalions (AH-64, UH-60, CH-47, HH-60), and the aggregate catalogue has no US Army rotary-wing unit (its US helicopters are the USMC AH-1 platoon/section); T23 is also refused on STP-833 route extent (first leg 74.2 km). A move of either stays REFUSED as a memberless container (RL-20260927-03).
